availability_audit: Chronology: Lavaridge Gym sits at the end of the cap-36 window (C22 Mt. Chimney raised the cap; C23 is Flannery). Every member's source map precedes Lavaridge Town in book play order: Route 103 (C02), Petalburg City ponds and Route 102/104 (C02-C05), Granite Cave and Altering Cave rock smash (C12 + Rock Smash license from C18 Mauville), Mauville Game Corner (C18). No Surf-gated water (C27), no Strength-gated area (granted only after Flannery), no legendary, no post-badge source. All evolution levels are at or below cap 36. Cap-42 re-check for this rerun: the window moved 36 -> 42 (FLAG_BADGE04_GET), which is the window the plan targets ('Medium cap40 levels 43/39/42/44/41/39' = 42 + offset - 2). No member changed, so every source is still a gate<=36 map preceding Lavaridge in book play order; nothing depends on the Heat Badge, Strength, Surf or any post-Lavaridge area. Chronology-legal gate-42 species (Skarmory Route113, Turtonator JaggedPass, Drampa MeteorFalls_1F_1R) were available and not used; the Surf-gated Meteor Falls rooms are not legal here (Surf is C27).
plan: Rain core against an all-Fire gym. Pelipper's Drizzle halves every Fire attack and powers Weather Ball/Liquidation; Swampert and Azumarill provide the Water damage; Garganacl is a Rock wall with Purifying Salt burn immunity; Gyarados brings Intimidate against the physical Fire attackers; Togekiss redirects with Follow Me. MIST RERUN: the room now authors Misty Terrain. That is a straightforward gain for this party and a direct test of the dossier's claim that the mist 'blocks new grounded status conditions, not the Flash Fire or Well-Baked Body ability boosts'. Swampert, Azumarill and Garganacl are grounded and should be unburnable by Magcargo's Lava Plume; Pelipper, Gyarados and Togekiss are airborne and remain burnable, which is the asymmetry to watch. Garganacl's Purifying Salt would have made it status-proof anyway, so the clean grounded-immunity evidence has to come from Swampert or Azumarill taking a Lava Plume. The activation half of the tactic must still fire: Lava Plume should light up an allied Flash Fire or Well-Baked Body regardless of the mist.
